steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Orchid... I, I'm still nervous.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Happens to everyone on their first mission. Don't worry, I'm here for you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Trust the time you've spent in the training room. You could give anyone a run for their money with your sword.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Gloompincers are really fierce, aren't they? If the villagers couldn't chase them away, I...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I won't pretend that they're not dangerous, but I guarantee you that they're not as scary as Instructor Dur-nar's sword, or Instructor Dobermann's whip.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: They approved you for this mission because they believe you have the skills.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: This is just the first step. It took you a long time to make up your mind, didn't it?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: So this is how it feels to sit in this car.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: When operators from the office came to find us, I was thinking maybe I should wait for the next chance. But I felt like this was a step that I had to take, and so I raised my hand.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I haven't seen Instructor Dobermann smile like that for ages. I'll get this mission done.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I want to use this sword to help protect more people.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's more like it.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Tell me about your first mission! I want to know how you felt.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Well, that was a long time ago. I was leading the squad...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Anyway, I almost quit after that mission.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But they started listening... I guess.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: So that's what they were like back then...

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Excuse me...

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Are you girls from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Yes, we are.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Why don't you explain our mission to them?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Hello, we're here from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: We'll set up defenses outside the village, and instruct you guys on how to set them up afterwards.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: The defenses are equipped with warning systems, giving you a chance to prepare the next time there's a gloompincer attack, and reducing the damage to the village.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: We'll also help you defeat them if they attack.

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Alright. Er... I have another question.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Well, you talk so slowly, and your sword is so thin. Why did Rhodes Island send someone like you?

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Can you really beat the gloompincers?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Excuse me? Please—

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Trust me, I can.

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Ah... well, I'm just speaking my mind here, but...

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: I figured a lady like you would be more comfortable reading a book and having tea, not doing rough stuff like this. Don't want you to get hurt, you know.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: We're really grateful you came to help, though.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Come in, we have tea and snacks if you like. We made them ourselves.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: The tea was great, thank you.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: It was from last year's harvest. The gloompincers made a mess of the tea fields this year, and we couldn't plant much in the fields we have left.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Life's hard.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Have you ever thought about leaving this place and doing something else?

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Where would we go? It's not that easy.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Even the factories are looking for people who've been to school. Folks like us, we just stick to our fields and see what our kids and grandkids can do.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Oh, it's nothing. I see you girls are pretty well-dressed. Is this some kinda upper-class hobby, coming out here to train?

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Know anyone who's hiring and pays a steady wage? We'd love to know.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Don't think we'll last more than a few more years, the way things are headed.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We're not exactly upper-class, just employees of our company.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But we could talk afterwards about your situation. We might be able to help somehow.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Oh, thank you so much.

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Hey! We spotted some gloompincers! Grab your weapons!

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Go, go!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Our village can't take much more of this! Please, help us chase them away!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: We'd really appreciate it!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Stay on high ground! We've got it covered down here!

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Don't worry, we've fought them plenty of times ourselves!

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: We'll guard this side, help lighten the load on you guys!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright! Just hold these barricades. Watch out for Arts from above!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: You guys can use Arts?

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Wow! I hear good casters can blow up a whole building by themselves! This'll be a piece of cake with you guys around!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't get too excited. I'm not that powerful.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Just being able to use Arts is amazing enough!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Look out! Wright, Patty, activate the shield's circuit!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A&B
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Wow, that's so cool!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: You're really letting us keep this?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: This way, you won't need to call us in every time something happens, and we get to save some time and effort.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: It's a win-win!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Wow, you guys are so nice!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Look out, Orchid! They're coming!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Did you get hurt?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Just a scratch on the shoulder. I can deal with it.
Bibeak tears off a piece of her outfit to wrap up the wound, revealing her neck.

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: (Hey, that thing on her neck... is that Originium?)

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: (What?)

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: (Shit!)

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Hey, you, you're Infected?!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Yeah! You've got rocks growing out of you!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: G-Get away from us!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: You're Infected, right?

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Damn, we even had tea together! Did I—

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Damn you, gloompincers, why do you keep coming for us?! Go get those damned Infected, would you?!
A villager throws some food in the direction of the squad.
The gloompincers follow the trail of the scent.

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Eat them!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: I-I'd rather have the gloompincers eat everything I own than catch Oripathy!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: How did you even get here?!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: You asked—

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: We never asked for any Infected!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: But we're helping you!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: You even invited us to your house!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: That's because we didn't know you were Infected!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: You lied to us! How is anyone supposed to tell when you hide your Originium under your clothes like that!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: What did you say?!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Get out! Get out!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Chase them out, gloompincers!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: What the heck are you babbling about? Oripathy doesn't spread through everyday contact!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: I'm not Infected, but I've worked with them for years, and I'm completely fine!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: You're not Infected? Then you're a nutjob!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Bill got the illness from who knows where, and he couldn't find a job after rocks started growing out of him, not even at the bottom of the mines!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Even after he died, he... our village is like this now because of the Infected!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: How dare you stroll in like you own the place! Are you trying to kill us all?

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Are you here to help us or kill us?!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Get out! All of you! We don't need your help!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator B
steps.text: You're the squad leader, Orchid. Your call.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator B
steps.text: Personally, I don't see a need to stay here and take this abuse and the gloompincers.

spans.text: Personally, I don't see a need to stay here and take this abuse

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let's finish this one off and leave, Bibeak. They've made their choice, and we have no obligation to stay.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll be coming down now. Go around the barricades, and we'll meet by the car!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Why should we have to be chased out like this...?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: We did nothing wrong!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: We came to—
Another piece of food flies towards Bibeak and lands by her feet. Nearby gloompincers detect the scent and converge upon her.
Orchid repels them with Arts and briefly keeps them away.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's not the first time something like this has happened, Bibeak. People try to get help from Rhodes Island without even reading the documentation.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But this is not a good situation to be in. We risk angering them further if we stay.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We should retreat before things get worse.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Are you afraid of failing a mission?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I... I don't know.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: It's my first field mission, and I don't want to give up like this.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: And we didn't do anything wrong!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I don't understand why they're driving us out after we helped them.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I used to hide behind my parents when I saw gloompincers. When someone hurt me, all I could think was 'what should I do?'

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: But I... I...

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I don't want to leave like this, getting chased away like this!
The gloompincers edge forward, becoming less afraid of Orchid's Arts by the second.
Bibeak swings her sword.
She has done so to protect others from angry mobs before, and she has done so countless times in training.
But today, she has only herself in mind when she swings her sword.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Are you doing this because I'm Infected?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Does that make me worse than the gloompincers that are tearing your homes apart? Am I so scary that you have to hide away like that?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Even though we said we don't infect others with Oripathy?
None of the villagers answer.
The swarm of gloompincers breaks through the barricade in front of the village.
Bibeak does not move her feet. She stands there holding her sword, raises it, swings it, and clenches her jaws.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (What a stubborn girl.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (She's seeing the mission as a testament to her own worth. She didn't need to drive herself into a corner like that.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (But if that's really how she's thinking of it...)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll help you out if you really want to do this, Bibeak.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Just take it easy. You're hurt.

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Damn it, the gloompincers are coming!

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Stand your ground! We'll stop them here!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Grab your bows and farm tools!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Shut the windows and doors and make sure they're locked tight!
More and more gloompincers rush towards the village, far more than originally expected.
At the same time, more and more villagers leave their houses and join the line.
The operators who've already begun preparing to evacuate look at Bibeak silently swinging her sword, sigh, and pick up their weapons again.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator B
steps.text: ...Shit. Fine.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator B
steps.text: Patty and I will go reinforce the barricades. This place is not where I want to die.

spans.text: Patty and I will go reinforce the barricades. This place is

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: I, I... stay away...

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: —My leg!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: If you're hurt, get out of the way.

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Stay away...! I, I can stand on my own...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: Oh, don't worry, I wouldn't dream of lending you a hand.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: The barricades are up! Over here, Orchid, Bibeak!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Coming!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: There's got to be an end to this!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: Behind you!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Thanks, bro! Er...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: Save it.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Er, thanks...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: Don't just stand there, move your damn ass!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator B
steps.text: You got anything better to do than stare? You say this village's so precious to you, but you're gonna leave a couple of Infected to fight for it?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator B
steps.text: Let me say this again: ordinary contact does not result in infection! Get your ass up here if you really want to chase away these gloompincers!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Fine, dammit!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Take this! B-But just stay over there, I, I'll throw it over!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator B
steps.text: Suit yourself. Couldn't care less one way or another.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: I, I'm scared! But I-I do have a conscience!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: You saved my life! I've got to do the right thing!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: We made this odor bag! Gloompincers don't like the smell! It'll hold them off for a bit!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Catch!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wright, look out for the other side...

steps.name: Frightened Voice
steps.text: Aaaagh—
A scream draws everyone's attention. A little girl is pointing in Bibeak's direction with terror on her face.
A gloompincer raises its claw behind Bibeak. She tries to raise her sword, but fatigue gets the best of her.
A bolt pierces it just as it was about to bring its claws upon her.
The villager who fired the bolt shields her frightened daughter, and cocks her crossbow without a word as she turns her attention to another gloompincer.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Are you okay, Bibeak? Pull back—

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I'm fine, Orchid.

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: T-They're coming!!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: Cut the chatter! Get your ass to the barrier!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: T-They're coming... I'm not scared!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Anyone who can still stand! Come and help them!

steps.name: Villager C
steps.text: Grab the improvised bombs! They'll at least do some damage!
The sun begins to set, and the gloompincers finally back off, realizing that they are not making any headway.
The villagers continue to stand where they are, in a daze from the furious fighting, feeling only the soreness in their hands.
Bibeak uses her sword as a cane to support her own weight, before turning to head towards the Rhodes Island vehicle parked at a distance.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Bibeak! Get in, and I'll bandage your wounds.
Some of the villagers look as though they want to take a step forward, before stopping in their tracks.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: I think we...

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Um, uh...

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Sorry... and thank you. It's getting late. We can pack some food for you to eat on the way.

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: I mean it!

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: No need. It's fine.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Orchid, I want some of those pastries you made.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: You brought some, didn't you?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yeah, they're in the car.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Shall we go then?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: There, all bandaged up.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: *Sobbing*...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It was hard, wasn't it? Go ahead, you can cry.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You were so brave. You didn't run back to the car crying; you came back on your own two feet after defeating the gloompincers.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You changed the villagers' thinking and got them to fight alongside us.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If it weren't for you, the rest of us would have turned around and left, venting about it the whole way back, and nothing would have changed.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Orchid...

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I told myself countless times that I can't wallow in hate. I can't turn myself into something terrible.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: But that's what I look like in the eyes of the uninfected.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: But I... I don't think they're wrong.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You don't have to console yourself like that, Bibeak.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Rhodes Island's documentation clearly stated that our squads contain Infected. It's their fault for not reading. The least they could have done was to handle it more politely, which we would have been able to accept.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: ...It's not consolation, Orchid, I really feel that way. It's only natural for them to be afraid, because... I'm afraid too. I hate and fear my condition.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I left home to come to Rhodes Island, in order to bring it under control. I participated in all that training to get this chance to conquer my fear...

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Maybe that's not something everyone can do.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: But I don't want to have done all that just to stop moving forward on my first field mission. Go backwards even.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Was I being selfish? If they were really scared, I shouldn't have—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Lie down and have something to eat. Don't think too much about it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: They were only afraid because they don't understand Oripathy. We've already explained that normal contact doesn't lead to infection.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: They calmed down and accepted that.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Will they ask for help from Rhodes Island again?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: If they do... will I be willing to accept the mission?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The choice is yours, Bibeak.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Everyone makes their own choices. If it were up to me... I'd probably turn it down after some thought.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: ...I don't know what I'd think.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Maybe they won't be scared of us next time. Or maybe they'll reject us again. Or maybe there won't even be a next time.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: But I'll wait for that day.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Gives Bibeak some pastries)

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Thanks for being with me today, Orchid.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Otherwise, I might have done something stupid.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: But I don't regret participating in this field mission, even if it was very different from what I imagined.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: I'll keep moving forward.
